about: M3 prefill zone-profiler zones (utils/profiler_utils.py zone(), rolled up by tests/perf/parse_zone_perf.py) -> ops of Pavlo's traffic-sim cost model (sim_core.js ZONE_MOE / ZONE_DENSE, zoneEff).
Zone paths are relative to the layer zone: profiled_chunk/layer03_sparse/<zone> (sparse = MSA + MoE, layers 3..59) and profiled_chunk/layer00_dense/<zone> (dense = GQA + dense MLP, layers 0..2).
Pavlo's statistic: per-zone device-kernel ms, MEAN over the stage's devices (parse_zone_perf.py --per-device, collect_calib.py zone_means), not the across-device max.

misc is not measured: misc = layer zone total - sum of the zones that map to a named op (sim_core zoneEff). Every zone listed under misc_zones therefore lands in misc automatically; do not add it anywhere else.

Level: the calibration profiles were taken at M3_PROFILE_LEVEL=2 (MEDIUM). FINE (level 3) zones nest inside or sit beside MEDIUM ones; the map below says where each FINE zone goes so a level-3 profile rolls up the same way.
Counts: norm_ag is two zones per layer (Pavlo fits one efficiency to their mean and charges it twice).

dense.attn/ring_joint_sdpa: ring (ring_c compute | ring_scan capacity walk, max of the two)

sparse: untracked ops under the layer zone (typecasts, reshapes, to_memory_config between zones)
dense: untracked ops under the layer zone

sim_roofline_of_each_op.norm_ag: one TP all-gather of the activation, (tp-1)/tp * T/sp * E * 2 B / 100 GB/s, per call (x2 per layer)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.qkv: max(matmul E x 9216/tp at HiFi2, weight read bf8)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.idx_branch: max(matmul E x 640/tp, weight read E x 640 bf8)  (index q/k projection only; no norm/rope FLOPs)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.misc: 8 activation passes of T/sp x E/tp bf16 over DRAM ('rope, residual, typecasts, cache write')
sim_roofline_of_each_op.o_proj: max(matmul 8192/tp x E, weight read bf8)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.attn_rs: one TP reduce-scatter, same bytes as norm_ag
sim_roofline_of_each_op.shared: max(3 matmuls E x 3072/tp, weight read bf16) + one TP reduce-scatter (the zone contains its tp_reduce_scatter)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.router: max(matmul E x 128 experts, weight read bf16)  (gate only; top-k and routing_setup are not in the roofline)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.dispatch: a2a over the SP line: sp * (Tr/sp * topk/tp * E * 1 B) / (4 * 50 GB/s); Tr = actual (unpadded) tokens
sim_roofline_of_each_op.experts: (routed FLOPs x 1.2 imbalance)/608 TF LoFi + (16 experts x 3 x E x 3072 bf4)/512 GB/s, SUMMED (today's kernel), max() when overlapped
sim_roofline_of_each_op.moe_reduce: weighted sum over topk (2 x Tr/sp x topk/tp x E x 2 B over DRAM) + one TP reduce-scatter
sim_roofline_of_each_op.ag_kv: (sp-1)/sp * kv_len * K+V bytes/token/chip (2 x Hkv/tp x 128 x bf8) / 100 GB/s
sim_roofline_of_each_op.ag_idx: (sp-1)/sp * kv_len * 128 x idx bytes (bf16 in the profiles) / 100 GB/s
sim_roofline_of_each_op.indexer: 2 * n/sp * 4 index heads * 128 * (2048 + kv_len/128) FLOPs at HiFi2
sim_roofline_of_each_op.sparse: max(4 * n/sp * 64/tp heads * min(2048, kv_len) * 128 FLOPs, selected K/V read / 32)
sim_roofline_of_each_op.dense_mlp: max(3 matmuls E x 12288/tp, weight read bf16) + one TP reduce-scatter
sim_roofline_of_each_op.ring: per segment max(ring_c = 4 * n/sp * 64/tp * (k + n/2) * 128 FLOPs, ring_scan = max(cap, kv_len)/sp * K+V bytes / 100 GB/s)

mismatches_and_caveats: routing_setup (FINE, inside mlp but outside dispatch) is NOT part of Pavlo's router or experts: at level 2 it is untracked mlp time and goes to misc. So misc (sparse) holds routing_setup + the front-end elementwise ops; Pavlo's misc roofline (8 DRAM passes) does not model routing_setup.
router = mlp/router_topk only. The roofline is the gate matmul; the top-k/sort inside the zone is not modelled, which is why router eff is ~5-7%.
shared includes its own tp_reduce_scatter (nested zone) in both zone and roofline: consistent.
moe_reduce includes the fused weighted sum AND the TP reduce-scatter (reduce_module): consistent. The profile_prefill.py docstring still calls it reduce_ws_rs; the code zone is moe_reduce.
attn/index_k_write is a sibling of attn/index_branch, not nested in it: it goes to misc, not idx_branch. attn/kv_write likewise goes to misc.

attn/o_proj_fused_rs (Ring CCL topology path) replaces attn/o_proj + attn/ccl_out_reduce_scatter; sim_core's ZONE_MOE has no entry for it, so zoneEff would find o_proj/attn_rs missing (their efficiencies clamp to 1.0) and push the fused time into misc. Split it before fitting, or fit o_proj+attn_rs jointly.

attn/ccl_out_allreduce / ccl_out_allgather (replicated-residual path) are costed by the sim as one reduce-scatter (attn_rs); an all-reduce moves ~2x the bytes, so the fitted efficiency would read ~2x low. The profiles used the sharded residual (ccl_out_reduce_scatter + norm all-gathers).
mlp/tp_allgather and mlp/pre_dispatch_allgather only exist on the replicated-residual path; the sim has no op for them (misc).

Dense 'dense_mlp' maps to the whole mlp zone (including its tp_reduce_scatter), and ring maps to attn/ring_joint_sdpa. In the pipeline sim the ring efficiency is NOT CAL.effs.dense.ring_c: makePlan uses CAL.pipe.ringC (fitted on the 16-stage runs, 0.302 for [2,4]) scaled by effs[mesh].ring_c / effs['2x4'].ring_c, and CAL.pipe.ringScan (0.014) for the capacity walk.

ag_idx fits eff = 1.0 (clamped) on [2,4]/[4,2]/[8,4]: the roofline (bf16 index_k over kv_len = 56,320) is larger than the measured zone minus the 0.04 ms CCL floor, so the model overstates ag_idx by ~0.02 ms/layer at the calibration point.

opEff = 0 (today) clips every measured efficiency at its target (matmul 70%, DRAM/link 80%): qkv (87.6%) and ag_idx (100%) run SLOWER in the sim than measured. A new CAL.effs entry above target has no effect.
experts eff is against read + compute summed (today's kernel is not overlapped) and includes a 1.2 expert-imbalance factor in the FLOPs; against max(read, compute) the same time is ~28%.
Sparse layers get an extra pipeline MoE multiplier (CAL.pipe.moeMult = 1.035 + 0.024 x 5120/T) fitted on the 2D-fabric 16-stage runs; zone profiles were 1D fabric.

Pavlo's zoneEff reads the MEAN over devices; the M3 zone reports' worst-chip (max) column will give lower efficiencies for skewed CCLs (in the [2,4] profile max/mean is 1.30 dispatch, 2.4 combine, 1.57 experts_mm, 1.53 moe_reduce).
